description.value: Nothing in the wastes is really scrap until you've stripped it twice. When you Repair an item using salvaged (rather than store-bought) components, reduce the cost in materials by an amount equal to your level (minimum 0).

cinderfall.incomplete: No rule-element key reduces the material cost of a Repair check by a scaling amount (here, the actor's level) -- downtime crafting/repair costs aren't exposed to a cost-modifying rule element in this corpus.
